metaDescription: Order custom gold koozies in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Great for events, bars, and promotions. Get a quick quote today!
introHtml: Gold koozies add a touch of elegance to any event or promotion. Whether you are outfitting a bar with branded drink sleeves or handing them out at a wedding, the metallic finish stands out from standard colors. Available in foam, neoprene, and can cooler styles, these koozies can be screen-printed or debossed with your logo. Perfect for marketing directors looking for a premium giveaway that keeps drinks cold and brands visible.
heroAltText: Custom gold koozies with metallic finish and logo imprint for promotional events
